verdict.rationale: LocalAI's own built-in web interface and its `local-ai chat` agent can read the user's files, answer questions about them, and pull live data through MCP servers, so users can get AI-generated answers about their data inside the product. However, this is general-purpose chat or agent prompting rather than a dedicated feature that proactively surfaces insights or suggestions. Missing for 10: a dedicated or proactive insights and suggestions feature over the user's data, documentation of the quality and depth of data analysis, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: It answers questions, reads your files and runs commands on your machine, asking you to approve anything that changes state.
local-ai chat reads your files and runs commands on your machine, behind an approval gate you control.
LocalAI comes with a **built-in web interface** for chatting with models, managing installations, configuring AI agents, and more, with no extra tools needed.
Connect to external MCP servers for live data
